subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which Gateway/UI surface should own read-only configured route and ACP binding visibility for the Agents channels panel?
rationale: The requested work adds a core Gateway protocol/read-model surface and a Control UI presentation path; current code has binding helpers but no maintainer-confirmed API namespace or UI ownership decision.

options.title: Approve normalized read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, and review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config read data
options.body: Have the UI derive the display from the existing config read surface, avoiding a new RPC at the cost of tighter coupling to raw config shape.

options.title: Defer UI visibility
options.body: Keep bindings visible through config/docs for now and pause or close the implementation PR until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve normalized read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, and review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on how the persistent binding model should be exposed to Gateway/UI consumers, and this person authored the merged binding feature.
